A '''Hutt''' who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] purposely held up a shipment of supplies to the [[Aduba-6 research outpost|research outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aduba-6]] out of greed, but was eventually convinced to release the shipment and send additional supplies free of charge.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|The Perils of Greed}}</ref>
